headline: How Do You Summon Slifer
title: How to Summon Slifer the Sky Dragon | Every Way | Yu-Gi-Oh Master Duel and TCG
video_script: How do you summon Slifer the Sky Dragon? Here are four ways, and one big catch you must know. Way one: Tribute three monsters to Normal Summon it. It cannot be Normal Set, but this Normal Summon cannot be negated, and no cards or effects can be activated when it lands. The easy way to get three Tributes is Ra's Disciple. When it is summoned, it Special Summons up to two more Ra's Disciple from your hand or Deck. Next turn, three Tributes are ready. Way two: Soul Crossing. During the Main Phase it Tribute Summons a Divine-Beast, and you can Tribute your opponent's monsters, so their field pays for your God. Way three: Special Summon it from the Graveyard with The Revived Sky God or Monster Reborn. The Revived Sky God also refills both hands to six cards. Way four: Ultimate Divine-Beast. When your opponent attacks, it Special Summons Slifer from your Graveyard in Defense Position, and the attack goes to Slifer. The catch: if Slifer was Special Summoned, it is sent to the Graveyard in the End Phase. So attack the turn you bring it back, or Normal Summon it to keep it. Which way do you use? Comment below!
